systems.country_label: base de dados das entidades competentes para emissão do Bilhete de Identidade
systems.owner: the entities competent to issue the Bilhete de Identidade (not named)
systems.tiers: not stated; the decree requires it to be shared with the tax authority's taxpayer register (art. 16)

note: A tax-number decree: the birth entry (assento de nascimento) appears only as one document on which the tax authority may assign a sequential NIF; nothing on how civil registration offices record births or deaths. The Registo Geral de Contribuintes it governs is a tax register, outside the study's classes.
